title: Unsigned Visitor
description:
During an authorized lab review of a fictional API, the analyst captured this JWT header segment:

```
eyJhbGciOiJub25lIiwidHlwIjoiSldUIn0
```

The payload is not required to answer the question. Decode the header and inspect the declared algorithm.
objective: Submit the declared JWT algorithm value as HC{algorithm}.

hints.text: The header segment is base64url-encoded JSON.
An algorithm of this value means the token is unsecured.
